column4: verify a union-find against its owner by the partition, not by representatives: one program drives both structures on the same seeded sequence, each side writes every partition-level observation (union and connected results, component sizes and count, refusals) and a canonical labelling digest (label = first member) to its own dump, and the dumps must be byte-identical; representatives are compared in process and only counted, so two compression schemes can be equivalent without equal roots
